To compute the forecast error for a given forecast at time k+i, use the observations at times 1, 2, ..., k+i-1 to estimate the forecasting model, and then compute the error on the forecast for k+i. Repeat this step for i = 2,...,T-k, where T is the total number of observations. Compute the forecast accuracy without any criticism of the able trial jurist who was following the decisions then existing.

In a separate context, reverse the two judgments adjudging the defendants of being guilty of a felony, and remand the causes to the trial court with directions to enter a judgment of guilty of Section 800.02 which is a different offense.
